info.title: Gripello API
info.description: The REST API the Gripello app uses. Sign in with `POST /auth/login` and send the returned token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors share one shape: `status`, `message`, `data`.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: memberships adds the caller's memberships (gym and role with permissions)

patch.description: Own profile fields only. platform_admin, verified, email, suspended_until, suspension_reason and password are refused with 403 (email and password have their own flows in authn). Publishes user.updated {record, changed} on user:<id>.

avatar.description: jpeg, png, svg, gif, webp; max 5 MB; thumbs 100x100, 320x320

banner.description: jpeg, png, webp; max 5 MB; thumb 1600x400

delete.description: Deletes the account and its files after checking the current password (400 `validation_invalid_password`); refused while the user is the only admin of a gym (400 `validation_last_admin` on field `gym`).

post.description: Adds the wall to followed_walls (idempotent); publishes user.updated with changed [followed_walls].

delete.description: Removes the wall from followed_walls; publishes user.updated with changed [followed_walls].

post.description: Starts a background export (job `account.export`, coalesced per user, 3 requests per hour). The zip of everything tied to the caller (JSON files, logbook.csv, own uploads; nothing above 2 GiB) lands in private storage and the user gets an e-mail with the link /account/export/<token> (7 days; a new export replaces the old one) and an `account_export_ready` notification linking the sign-in page /account/export. An export over the cap is stored as failure `too_large` and announced as `account_export_failed` plus a mail.

get.description: State of the caller's latest unexpired export.
Streams the caller's latest ready export (session cookie or bearer; range requests supported); 404 without one.
Streams the export the token belongs to (range requests supported). Needs no session; unknown, expired and deleted-account links answer 404.
Own reviews and beta videos, newest first, 200 each.

Signed in. Progress is computed live; `earned` holds the stored day per reached tier ('' until the queued evaluation stores it). Grade-based families only for the climber themself. Others need a connection (viewer follows them accepted, or they follow the viewer) and get 404 without one, when the climber's sends are private, or when the climber blocked the viewer; for them `current` is 0 and `earned` holds only '' per reached tier, and results may be up to 60 s old. 60 requests per minute per user.
Rows of the gym. view_audit_log and platform admins see every row, other signed-in users only their own.
The caller's own rows across every gym, including gym-less auth rows.
Platform admins only; every row, optionally of one gym.

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: gym id or slug

get.description: Only password login is offered, second factors are per account.

post.description: Password login (identity = email or username). Needs the X-Cap-Token header (scope login) when CAP_SECRET is set. Accounts with second factors get 401 {mfaId, methods}. 10 failures in 15 min lock the account (429).

401.description: Second factor required, or an error

post.description: Second step with an authenticator code.
Second step with a single-use recovery code.
Starts a discoverable passkey login; the ceremony expires after 10 minutes.
Passkey login; a full login on its own, the second step when mfaId is sent. Ignores the lockout.
Re-signs the token with the same session (tokens without a session get one) and touches the session.
Ends the current session.

Only while settings.allow_registration is on; needs X-Cap-Token (scope register) when CAP_SECRET is set. Answers 202 without a body whether or not the e-mail is taken: a free address gets the verification mail, a taken one an 'already registered' mail to its owner. Username defaults to users + 6 digits.
Always 204. Guests need X-Cap-Token (scope password-reset) when CAP_SECRET is set.
Sets the password, verifies the email, ends all sessions and clears the lockout. Tokens live 30 min.
Always 204; mails only unverified accounts. Needs X-Cap-Token (scope verification) when CAP_SECRET is set.
Tokens live 7 days; the password proves the link belongs to the clicker (a sign-up retry replaces it).
Signed in. Mails a confirmation link to the new address; a taken address answers the same 204 and its owner gets an "already registered" mail.
Needs the current password; ends all sessions. Tokens live 30 min.
Ends every session and returns a new login for this device.

Stores state, PKCE verifier and nonce (single use, 10 minutes), sets the HttpOnly gripello_oauth2 flow cookie and returns the provider URL. link=true needs sign-in and links the identity to the caller. redirect must be a same-origin path. native=true (native apps, which open the URL in the system browser) makes the callback return to the app scheme `app.gripello:` instead of the app URL; the app's WebView holds the flow cookie and redeems the ticket. 404 for unknown or disabled providers.

get.description: Provider redirect target (Apple posts the same fields as a form). Verifies the id_token and redirects to /auth/login?oauth2=<ticket>[&redirect=], to /account/settings?tab=security after linking, or to /auth/login?oauth2Error=failed|registration_disabled|account_exists|already_linked|email_unverified (errors of a link flow go to /account/settings?tab=security). Native flows use `app.gripello:` in place of the app URL. Accounts are linked by email only for provider-verified addresses on verified accounts, never for Microsoft.

post.description: Apple's form_post variant of the callback (application/x-www-form-urlencoded with code, state, id_token).
Signs in with the ticket from the callback. Only works in the browser holding the flow cookie (login CSRF). Lockout, suspension and second factors apply as for password login (401 {mfaId, methods}).

401.description: Second factor required, or an error

post.description: Links the identity of a link ticket (callback of a link flow) to the signed-in account. Needs the flow cookie of the browser that started the flow and the same account, so a provider URL sent to someone else links nothing.

get.description: The caller's linked sign-in providers and whether the account has a password.

delete.description: 409 when it is the last way in (no password, passkey or other provider).

post.description: Confirms the password; sensitive platform actions accept this session for five minutes. Wrong passwords count toward the lockout.

get.description: Own second factors.

delete.description: Needs the password; removing the last factor drops the recovery codes.

post.description: Needs the password. Returns a new secret and otpauth URI; nothing is stored yet.
Stores the authenticator after a valid code.
Needs the password; replaces all recovery codes.
Needs the password.
Finishes the registration ceremony.

get.description: Own sessions, most recently seen first.

delete.description: Revokes the token and drops the session's realtime auth.

post.description: Revokes every session but the current one.

get.description: Archives in BACKUP_DIR, newest first, plus the schedule settings and whether a run is queued or running. enabled is false with BACKUP_DIR=off. Platform admins only.

pg_dump.description: Whether pg_dump is installed on the replica that answered.

put.description: How many daily archives to keep (0 = no schedule) and whether uploads are included. Needs a recent password confirmation.

get.description: Streams the archive as an attachment. Needs a recent password confirmation (cookie auth works, so a plain link can download).

delete.description: Deletes the archive. Needs a recent password confirmation; audited.

get.description: Drafts only for manage_competitions.

parameters.description: repeatable or comma-separated; matches any

post.description: manage_competitions in the gym. The location must belong to the gym. Status defaults to draft; freeze_at is stamped from ends_at - freeze_minutes when live_ranking is on.

get.description: Drafts are 404 without manage_competitions.

patch.description: manage_competitions. The location must stay in the gym. Setting status to published copies tops into the logbook and notifies the entrants, like POST /competitions/{id}/publish.

delete.description: manage_competitions. Deletes entries (and their scores) first, then categories and routes.

post.description: manage_competitions. Sets status published; on every transition the competition's ticks are replaced: each non-voided top of a registered or checked-in entry becomes a tick (flash for top_attempt 1, dated noon UTC of the end day or today, note = competition name, skipped when the climber already has a tick on that route that day) and every non-withdrawn entrant gets competition_published.

get.description: Visible unless the competition is a draft the caller can't manage. Sorted by sort, name.

post.description: manage_competitions.

delete.description: manage_competitions. 400 while entries use it.

get.description: Visible unless a draft the caller can't manage. Sorted by number; items carry expand.route (with expand.wall).

post.description: manage_competitions. The route must be in the competition's gym and of the discipline's type (Boulder/Route); rope routes drop zone, boulders drop hold_count. 400 while the competition is published.

patch.description: manage_competitions. A different `competition` is rejected; 400 while the competition is published.

delete.description: manage_competitions. Deletes its scores; 400 while the competition is published.

get.description: manage_competitions sees every entry, judge_competitions too unless the competition is a draft; others their own plus not-hidden entries of a non-draft competition, with user emptied and birth_year, guardian_consent and paid zeroed on other climbers' entries (a `user` filter for somebody else returns nothing). Sorted by bib; items carry expand.category.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: repeatable or comma-separated

post.description: Signed in. Climbers register themselves while status is open and ends_at is ahead; user, status, paid and bib are server-owned for them (bib = highest + 1) and the birth year must fit the category. Managers may register any user with any status, bib and paid; that user gets a competition_entry_added notification and may withdraw. Under 16 needs guardian_consent.

patch.description: manage_competitions or the owner. Owners can't change competition, user, bib or paid (ignored); they may withdraw (unless disqualified, and only before the competition closes), re-register while registration is open, and change category only then. A different `competition` from a manager is rejected. 403 for display_name/hidden changes while moderation keeps the entry hidden.

get.description: manage/judge_competitions see all; others the scores of their own entry, and everyone's once published or while live_ranking runs on a non-draft competition before freeze_at.

put.description: Upserts by (entry, comp_route) in one transaction. Judges and managers score any entry but their own (scored as a climber); climbers only their own active entry, while the competition is open and inside starts_at..ends_at, never voided routes or lead_height, and never over a score a judge wrote (403). Judges don't score drafts. Scores are normalised to the discipline (zone/top clamping, rope style, lead height from hold_count).

get.description: Ranked standings per category. visibility follows resultsVisibility; hidden and frozen return no categories. Managers get live standings with real names of hidden entries (drafts too) unless view=public; everyone else gets a per-replica cache dropped on every competition_changes event. Drafts are 404 for non-managers.

200.description: Joined; token and record are present when an account was created

post.description: Anyone, guests included; needs the Cap token header (scope `report`) when CAP_SECRET is set. The gym, content snapshot (max 5000 chars) and content_url are derived from the content; status and decision fields are server-owned. Notifies the gym's manage_reports holders (`report_filed`) and, unless the reason is `other`, the platform admins (`report_filed_platform`); mails the receipt to the notifier and the alert to the report handlers. Reporting hidden content closes the report at once with that decision.

get.description: Counts for nav badges. With `gym`: manage_comments or manage_reports there (or platform admin) → {decide, waiting, hidden}. Without: platform admins → {decide, legal_reports, profiles, suspended, gyms}.

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: gym id or slug

get.description: The inbox. `gym` is required unless the caller is a platform admin; gym access needs manage_comments or manage_reports. Items carry `context`. Default order: most reports first, then oldest.

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: gym id or slug

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: repeatable (`state` or `state[]`); matches any

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: platform admins only (403 otherwise), so gym staff can't unmask anonymous reviewers

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: `true` adds `total`

post.description: Opens (or returns) the case of content from before the inbox existed. manage_comments in the content's gym or platform admin, else 404.

get.description: Platform admins, or manage_comments/manage_reports in the case's gym. With `context`.

post.description: manage_comments in the case's gym or platform admin (else 404). approve: unreviewed, or pending for gym staff (publishes the held upload). reject: pending, gym staff. hide: unreviewed/approved, pending only for the platform; quarantines the content (reviews/betas are deleted with their files moved into the case, routes archived, profiles/entries/tasks cleared) and sets hidden_by gym|platform. restore: hidden; only the platform restores hidden_by=platform; recreates the same id. hide and reject need a reason. Closes every open report of the content (DSA decision mails) and notifies the author. Emits `content.hidden`/`content.restored` on topic `moderation`.
Platform admins. Hides every review and beta of the user (profile excluded); one notice and one statement of reasons.

get.description: The caller's bell, newest first. Live changes arrive on realtime topic `own_notifications` as {action, record}.

parameters.name: unread
parameters.description: true = only unread

post.description: Marks the given own notifications (or all) read; foreign ids are ignored.

get.description: Public. VAPID key and the mutable topics; `permission` limits who is offered a topic (`platform_admin` = platform admins). `enabled` = Web Push is configured, `native` = FCM for the native apps is configured.

put.description: Replaces the opt-outs. Only channel `push` and known topic keys are accepted; unset means on.

post.description: Web Push (`kind` webpush, the default): the endpoint must be https on a known push service (FCM, Apple, Mozilla, WNS). An existing endpoint of the caller is updated; one of another user moves to the caller (same id) only when p256dh and auth match, else 409. Native apps (`kind` fcm) send their FCM registration token as `endpoint` and no keys; the token moves to whoever signs in on that device.
Sends a test push to one of the caller's own devices. 3 per minute per user.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: case-insensitive substring of email, username, firstname or name

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: only members of this gym

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 0 returns every match unpaged (page 1, limit 0)

200.description: Account counts for the users page

patch.description: Profile fields only. Another platform admin can't be edited. The user's own settings (notification_prefs, followed_walls, leaderboard_hidden, follow_policy, reviews_anonymous, ticks_private), platform_admin, suspension and credentials answer 403. A new email needs a password confirmation from the last five minutes (POST /me/reauthenticate, else 403 reauth_required). Sends user.updated {record, changed, actor} on `user:<id>`.

delete.description: Not yourself (DELETE /me) or another platform admin (403), not the only admin of a gym (400). Needs a password confirmation from the last five minutes (POST /me/reauthenticate, else 403 reauth_required). Revokes every session and sends user.deleted {id, actor}.

post.description: Not yourself, not another platform admin. Needs a password confirmation from the last five minutes (POST /me/reauthenticate, else 403 reauth_required). Rotates the token key, deletes every session (session.revoked each) and mails the user.

get.description: Request counts of every replica (5-minute buckets, 60-day retention) for the overview. Platform admins only.

200.description: Series, totals with the previous window, endpoints, people and system state

system.description: Database, jobs, backup and mail state plus replicas: every server seen within 15 minutes (name, version, role, started, last_seen, online, realtime_clients, memory_bytes, strain: capacity problems of an online replica).

get.description: Database, jobs, backup and mail state plus the replicas, without traffic. `pg_dump_missing` is set while backups are on and pg_dump is not installed. Platform admins only.

200.description: Members and active routes per gym plus totals

put.description: Replaces the gym's flags; unknown flags and non-booleans answer 400. Sends gym.updated (the gym record) on `gym:<id>`.

delete.description: Served by authn. Deletes the user's second factors and recovery codes, ends every session and emails the user. Needs a recent password confirmation; refuses yourself and other platform admins (403).

get.description: Served by authn. The user's sessions, most recently seen first.

delete.description: Served by authn. Ends every session of the user (realtime connections lose their auth). Refuses yourself and other platform admins.
Served by authn. Clears failed sign-in attempts and an active lockout. Refuses yourself and other platform admins.

post.description: Served by authn. Sets a new password, ends every session, clears the lockout and emails the user. Needs a recent password confirmation; refuses yourself and other platform admins.

get.description: Blocked and allowed e-mail patterns (address, domain, *.domain for subdomains), protected name terms and the synced disposable-domain sources. The allowlist overrides the blocked list and the sources.

put.description: Replaces the three lists (trimmed, lowercased, deduplicated, sorted; sources are ignored). Invalid entries come back as blocked_emails.{i} / allowed_emails.{i} / protected_names.{i}; protected terms need 3 letters.

post.description: How the given (possibly unsaved) lists plus the enabled sources treat an e-mail address and/or a name, and which rule decided (allowed exception first, then the blocked list, then sources).
Appends e-mail patterns to the stored list.

get.description: The source's stored domains, 100 per page, sorted; q filters by substring.
What blocking the user's address or domain would cover; counts leave the user out, freemail marks public providers.
The stored mail settings, or the environment's (source environment) or none. The SMTP password is never returned, only smtp_password_set.

post.description: Sends a test email to the caller over the live transport; 5 per minute per admin, 409 when mail is not configured, 400 carries the SMTP error.

get.description: The newest 2000 log records of every replica (kept 7 days), newest first, at or above level and matching every given filter.

delete.description: Needs a password confirmation from the last five minutes (POST /me/reauthenticate, else 403 reauth_required). Removing your own rights or a non-admin answers 400; admin rows are locked, so of two admins revoking each other the second gets 403. The user gets an email.

get.description: Public, ordered by sort, name.

Either a search (`q`, at least 3 characters, 30 searches per minute per user, up to 3 words each matching first name, last name or username; 20 results; never yourself or closed profiles) or a lookup (`ids`, comma-separated, up to 200). Climbers who blocked the caller and closed profiles the caller is not connected to are left out. Rate-limited to 120 requests per minute per user (shared with /climbers/{id}).
404 when the climber blocked the caller, or has a closed profile and neither follows the caller nor is followed (accepted) by them. Rate-limited like /climbers.
Follows the caller is part of, newest first. Changes arrive on the realtime topic `follow_changes` as `{action, record}` for both parties.

post.description: The followee's follow_policy decides the status — approve (default) → pending, open → accepted. Yourself, an unknown climber, a closed profile or a block in either direction all answer the same 400; an existing follow answers 400 validation_not_unique. Follow creates and deletes share a limit of 60 per hour per user (429).
Only the followee (404 for anyone else); 400 unless the request is pending.

delete.description: Either party (unfollow, decline, remove a follower). Shares the follow limit of POST /follows.

get.description: Climbers the caller blocked, newest first.

post.description: Ends follows in both directions and hides the caller's search entry and profile from the blocked climber.

delete.description: Own blocks only (404 otherwise).

get.description: Pings the database within 2 s; never cached.
Answers while the process serves requests, without touching the database; for container liveness and readiness probes. Never cached.
Realtime clients connected to the replica answering.

put.description: The auth of this request becomes the stream's principal; `since` replays what the previous principal couldn't receive.

204.description: Applied by the replica holding the stream

post.description: A token for the files of one record; protected tables (tasks, moderation_items) need staff rights in the record's gym (404 otherwise).

get.description: Immutable file URL; protected tables need `token`.

manage_tasks. Items carry expand.route (summary), expand.wall and expand.reporter/assignee/done_by (climbers). Live: realtime topic `tasks:<gym>` (manage_tasks holders) delivers `{action: create|update|delete, record}` (kinds task.created/updated/deleted, record without expand) for every create, update, assign, status change and delete.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: repeatable (`status` or `status[]`); matches any

parameters.name: assignee
parameters.description: user id or `none`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: case-insensitive substring of title, description, route name or wall name

parameters.name: urgent
parameters.description: `true` = priority 4 only

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: `true` = due before today and still open (open, in_progress, waiting)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: comma-separated keys, `-` prefix = descending; keys: priority, due_date, created, updated, done_at, status, kind. Default -priority,due_date,-created.

post.description: Anyone, guests included. Without manage_tasks the task becomes a defect (or stays a wish) with title, assignee and due date cleared and the default priority. Status, reporter, done stamps and resolution note are server-owned. Location and wall derive from the route (or the wall); they must belong to the gym. Urgent defects mail every manage_tasks holder except the reporter, right away and then at most once per 15 minutes per gym with every urgent defect filed since.

photo.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB

201.description: The task for manage_tasks holders, only its id for everyone else

get.description: manage_tasks. Members of the gym holding manage_tasks (task_assignees view), sorted by name.
Public. Open (open, in_progress, waiting) defects of the gym's routes.
Public. Open defects of one route.
manage_tasks in the task's gym.

patch.description: manage_tasks. Kind, reporter and done stamps are ignored; closing stamps done_at/done_by, reopening clears them. 403 for description/photo changes while moderation keeps the report hidden.

post.description: manage_tasks. Marking a task done notifies its reporter.

get.description: The logbook, newest first. `expand.route` (with `expand.gym`) is set while the route exists; otherwise the snapshot fields (route_name, grade*) remain.

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: gym id; only ticks on its routes

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: day (YYYY-MM-DD) at or after; an RFC 3339 timestamp counts as its UTC day

post.description: grade, grade_system, grade_index and route_name are copied from the route. A flash always has one attempt. Dates more than 36 h ahead are rejected. A client-chosen `id` (15 chars a-z0-9) makes offline replays idempotent; a duplicate answers 400 with `data.id.code = validation_pk_invalid`.

user.description: must be the caller when sent

get.description: Ids of routes the caller has sent (tick_sends view).

patch.description: Own ticks only (404 otherwise). user, route, grade, grade_system, grade_index and route_name are locked; sending a different value answers 400.

get.description: Ticks of climbers the caller follows (accepted, ticks not private), without notes, with `climber` and `expand.route`.

parameters.name: gym
parameters.description: only routes of this gym id

get.description: All own ticks for yourself; a followed climber's ticks (no notes) when the follow is accepted and their ticks aren't private; otherwise no items. Paged like /me/ticks (limit up to 1000).

Public. Per climber the best 10 distinct sends in the window score grade_index × 100 (+33 per flash). Without a season the window is the rolling last 60 days. Climbers with leaderboard_hidden or ticks_private are left out. `me`, `ahead` and `mySends` are filled for a signed-in climber on the board.
Public, newest start first.

post.description: Needs manage_competitions in the gym.

AuditPage.description: One page of audit entries, newest first

User.description: Own user record (no password hash or token key)

notification_prefs.description: {channel: {topic: false}}, max 4000 bytes; unset means on

actor.description: empty for guests and deleted users

token.description: HS256 JWT with claims id, type, refreshable, sid, exp

recoveryCodes.description: Only with the first factor or when none are left

hour.description: UTC hour of the daily run (at :30).

Scoring.description: ScoringSettings of shared/utils/competitionScoring.ts without format; unknown keys are rejected

scoring_format.description: boulder: dynamic, fixed, ifsc, tops; rope: route_points, lead_height, dynamic

OpeningHours.description: {mon…sun, holiday: [["07:00","23:00"]]}; closes < opens runs past midnight

TvSettings.description: In-gym TV screens (/{gym}/tv?screen={id}); null = one screen with every slide, 12 s

screens.description: Screen ids are unique; an unknown or missing ?screen= shows the first

takeover.description: A running competition takes over the screen

announcements.description: Shared by every screen that shows the announcements slide

until.description: Last day the announcement is shown (YYYY-MM-DD); empty = no end

PrivacyDoc.description: Editor document of the privacy page; null = default page. A top-level paragraph holding only a mention ({type: paragraph, content: [{type: mention, attrs: {id}}]}) places a built-in section, each id at most once, controller and rights required; other nodes (heading, paragraph, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, text with bold/italic/strike/code/link marks, hardBreak) are the gym's own text, a level-2 heading starts a section. At most 100000 characters serialised.

trial_ends_at.description: Set while the gym is on trial; staff are read-only once it passed. Platform admins only.

GymInput.description: Any subset of the fields; file fields only accept null or "" (clear), uploads go through multipart.

page_logo.description: jpeg, png, svg, webp; max 5 MB

sign_image.description: jpeg, png, svg, webp; max 5 MB

allOf.description: trial_ends_at only for members and platform admins; GET /gyms leaves out privacy_doc and tv_settings

members.description: Number of memberships holding the role

email.description: Only when the user made it visible

ModerationItem.description: Realtime: topic `moderation:<gym>` (manage_comments; author left out) and `moderation:platform` (platform admins) carry {action: create|update|delete, record}. `author` and `snapshot.user` are blank when the viewer may not know the author.

snapshot.description: moderated fields; `_files` maps file fields to quarantined names, `_pending` marks a hidden held upload

files.description: protected; served from /files/moderation_items/{id}/{name} with a file token

actions.description: decisions POST /moderation/{id} accepts from the viewer right now, in button order; null in realtime records

reports.description: newest 20; explanation and notifier_name only for manage_reports holders and platform admins

notice.description: Upstream license notice downloaded with the list (MIT), empty for CC0.

online.description: accounts with a session seen in the last 2 minutes (open realtime streams refresh it every 30 s)

unverified_old.description: unverified and created more than 48 hours ago, so the verification link has expired

PlatformUser.description: The users row without password_hash and token_key, plus memberships.

avatar.description: file URL with a 100x100 thumb, or empty

Rating.description: The author's user id is never returned; `mine` and `author` only for signed-in viewers.

points.description: at least 3 points; a line needs 2

level.description: height of a structure; omitted means 1

removal_planned_for.description: planned strip date, cleared on archive

sends_count.description: distinct climbers with a send; only on GET /routes/{id}

period.description: YYYY-MM-DD (day, week = its Monday) or YYYY-MM (month)

grade.description: label, `?` when empty, `<grade> · <system>` when the gym mixes systems

expected.description: share among all matching routes incl. archived, scaled to the current count

gradeFeedback.description: routes with at least 3 grade votes, largest deviation first

votedGrade.description: mean grade index of the votes

name.description: full "First Last", the username when both are empty

follow.description: the caller's follow of this climber

sends_visible.description: yourself, or an accepted follow of a climber whose ticks are not private

priority.description: 0/absent = default (4 for urgent defect categories, else 2)

route.description: empty once the route is deleted

SeasonInput.description: ends_at must not lie before starts_at (one-day seasons are fine); gym can't change.

To.name: to
To.description: inclusive upper bound on created, same formats as from
